script_bundle.full_spoken_script: Welcome to briefing IDEA-01: Stopping Infinite Agent Loops & Runaway Token Bills. In production enterprise deployments, Production Google Cloud ADK and Zero-Trust MCP runtime. Using canonical blueprint T67 and runnable repository gcp-loop-breaker-circuit-adk, we enforce deterministic guardrails, zero-trust OAuth 2.1 token exchange, and 100-trial evaluation gates. Measured benchmark outcome: 98.0% eval accuracy across 100 trials. Clone the full repository and 12-slide deck directly from the Studio.
